name: Billet
description: Upright oblongs strewn semé, a few of them laid on their side.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; top: 12%; width: 40%; height: 76%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.32) { :after { -webkit-transform: rotate(90deg); transform: rotate(90deg); } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
